text:
Hiro Tanaka: Flagging a behavioural mismatch noticed in the console review: toasts vanish too quickly when users are scanning dense result tables. We need a policy for toast duration + keyboard interactions.
Zoe Martinez: Saw that too. Users on keyboard nav often miss ephemeral toasts. Proposal: default toast timeout 4s, but extend to 10s when table has focus or when toast follows a keyboard-triggered action.
Caleb Rivers: Agree on longer time for keyboard. Can we add a `data-toast-trigger="keyboard"` attribute so JS can apply the extended timer?
Maya Kapoor: Also consider a global token: `--toast-duration-default` and `--toast-duration-keyboard`. Keep default short for mouse workflows but accessible for keyboard.
Hiro Tanaka: Good idea. Suggested tokens: `--toast-duration-default: 4000ms`, `--toast-duration-keyboard: 10000ms`, `--toast-pause-on-hover: true`.
Zoe Martinez: Small UX nit: if the toast is actionable (has a button), it should be persistent until dismissed. We should treat action toasts as sticky by default.
Caleb Rivers: Implementation-wise: 
```
if (toast.hasAction) { toast.setPersistent(true); }
if (trigger === 'keyboard') { toast.duration = var(--toast-duration-keyboard); }
```
Maya Kapoor: Accessibility point: keyboard users need focus to be able to reach toast actions. When a toast appears due to a keyboard event, auto-move focus to the toast only if it is critical. Otherwise, provide an ARIA live region message and keep focus in context.
Hiro Tanaka: Agreed. Policy: non-critical toasts use polite live region; critical or action toasts get focus trap/push only if `data-toast-priority="high"`.
Zoe Martinez: QA found a case where toast appears while table row is in edit mode and steals focus. Add rule: if a form control is focused, do not move focus to toast.
Caleb Rivers: I'll add guard: `if (document.activeElement.tagName !== 'INPUT' && !isFormControl(document.activeElement)) { /* focus toast */ }`.
Maya Kapoor: Spacing tokens: when toasts appear above a pinned table header, they overlap header shortcuts. Add `--toast-anchored-offset` so teams can anchor below fixed headers. Default `--toast-anchored-offset: 56px`.
Hiro Tanaka: Good call. Also request for docs: show examples for keyboard flow, include code sample for `data-toast-trigger="keyboard"` and `data-toast-priority`.
Zoe Martinez: Copy micro: change generic "Saved" toast to include noun when triggered from table inline edits: "Row saved" -> "Row saved — changes applied".
Caleb Rivers: Will add i18n key `toast.inlineEdit.saved=Row saved — changes applied`.
ui-qa-bot: Automated check: visual test failed in narrow viewport where sticky toast covers action menu. Flagged storybook story `Table/with-inline-edit`.
Hiro Tanaka: Action items: Caleb add attributes & timers, Maya write accessibility guidance (when to focus vs live region), Zoe update copy variants and token docs, QA to add visual test for anchored offset. Aim to land before next minor. :spiral_calendar:
Maya Kapoor: I'll draft the docs and include code samples and ARIA patterns.
Caleb Rivers: I'll push a small PR with the attribute-driven behavior and token defaults. Snippet: 
```
.toast { transition: opacity .18s ease; }
:root { --toast-duration-default: 4000ms; --toast-duration-keyboard: 10000ms; --toast-anchored-offset: 56px; }
```
Zoe Martinez: Thanks team. This should reduce missed success messages and improve keyboard discoverability. :white_check_mark:
